text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the runtime degradation — need a sweep of runbook/playbook items.
meera: on it. I'll draft a triage checklist for KV cache thrash and verify commands.
jonah: I'll handle escalation matrix changes (who gets paged when Dedicated falls back).
linh: I'll prototype an automation PR to add a "one-click" playbook button in Console.
alex: Top priorities: (1) clarify triage steps and key commands, (2) explicit escalation mapping, (3) automation + Console affordance, (4) add regression evals. Owners and due dates? :calendar:
meera: assign to me for triage steps. ETA 2026-03-27. I'll include snippets and failure signatures.
meera: snippet:
```bash
kubectl logs -n inference --selector=app=runtime --tail=200 | grep -i "evict"
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 500 | grep -i "kvcache" || true
```
jonah: propose escalation flow in playbook: S1 -> page SRE oncall -> if no ack in 5m escalate to infra-sre -> after 15m page oncall-manager. I'll add explicit contact list.
linh: opened automation PR #45: adds `runbook.trigger` webhook + a sample `runbook.button` for Console. ETA 2026-03-29.
ops-bot: Created ticket TKT-4873 and linked PRs.
alex: meera: include fallback decision criteria: when to increase Dedicated burst vs route to fallback-quantized. Add example rollout snippet: `route: fallback-quantized\nmax_retries: 2\nmax_latency_ms: 2000`.
meera: added note about thresholds. Also adding test prompts for Redwood Optimize alerts.
jonah: LGTM on PR content. Also adding `pagerduty: infra-sre` mapping in escalation matrix.
linh: added test command that reproduced the behavior locally: `scripts/cache_warm.sh --prefix /tmp/test`.
alex: Assign final owners: meera (triage/checklist) due 2026-03-27, jonah (escalation mapping) due 2026-03-30, linh (automation + Console) due 2026-03-29. I'll add follow-up to oncall sync and set weekly review cadence.
meera: ack :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder posted: TKT-4873 updated with owners and due dates.
alex: Thanks team — closing thread; please push PR links here when ready.
meera: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/342
linh: automation PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/playbooks/pull/45
jonah: escalation change request: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/pagerduty/changes/19
alex: noted and added Monday 10:00 recurring invite "Incident Runbook Sweep". See calendar.
